objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-admin-permission-discovery
objects.description: The following analytic identifies the creation of a suspicious file named 'win.dat' in the root directory (C:\). It leverages data from the Endpoint.Filesystem datamodel to detect this activity. This behavior is significant as it is commonly used by malware like NjRAT to check for administrative privileges on a compromised host. If confirmed malicious, this activity could indicate that the malware has administrative access, allowing it to perform high-privilege actions, potentially leading to fu
